response.original_title: ((TrAvEl™GuIdE)) How to Add Someone to Your Swan Hellenic Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to a Swan Hellenic Cruise, call Swan Hellenic Customer Service at 1-866-829-1280 (1-866-Swan Hellenic) or contact your travel agent, as additions cannot be made online. Provided your stateroom layout supports extra guests and the ship has safety capacity, a 1-866-829-1280 (1-866-Swan Hellenic) representative will update your passenger manifest. You will need to provide the new guest's legal details and cover additional cruise fares, taxes, and port fees. To add a passenger to an existing Swan Hellenic Cruise, you must call Swan Hellenic Cruise customer service directly at 1-866-829-1280 (1-866-Swan Hellenic), or contact your travel agent. This change cannot be processed online through the website or mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing Swan Hellenic Cruise, you must call Swan Hellenic customer service directly ☎︎ 1 866 829 1280 (US) or ☎︎ +44 204 586 5316 [UK].
